items.title: The cat that is not waving hello
Something Is Watching Shinjuku
items.task: Find the enormous creature hiding above street level before anyone points it out.
items.reveal: Godzilla. A kaiju: a giant screen-monster that Japan made famous.

moreInfo.title: Kaiju
moreInfo.text: Godzilla began as a film about fear and the sea. The head on this building is a shop-sign and a local joke.
